note: A statement by theoretical high-energy physicists, signed by Edward Witten, Juan Maldacena and Nathan Seiberg among others, saying major results produced by AI companies in the field should be released openly and in full, while acknowledging that companies are still working out how best to share them. It applies to theoretical physics the case for open release of AI-produced results.
title: A Statement on Sharing Research Results Produced by AI Companies in Theoretical High-Energy Physics
who: Theoretical high-energy physicists (356 signatories at the time of checking; organisers not named)
